name: Select
description: A single-selection dropdown picker. The trigger reuses the button variant table and the popover primitive; the popup is the menu component's surface and rows; the search field is the input component.

fields.trigger: ButtonVariantStyle? - per-state trigger rows merged over the variant
fields.itemPadding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? - option row padding; null = px-2 py-1.5
fields.constraints: BoxConstraints? - popup size; null = 192-320 wide, 240 high (always trigger-wide)

accessibility.keyboard: trigger: Tab/Enter/Space opens. Popup: the menu engine's traversal (ArrowUp/Down move and wrap, Home/End jump, Enter/Space activates, Escape closes one level, typeahead selects by prefix); the search field takes focus when it is shown
accessibility.semantics: the trigger is a button; option rows are menu buttons; disabled triggers and rows dim to 50% opacity

sizes.popup: min-width 192 (12rem), max-width 320, max-height 240 before scrolling, p-1 (4) surface
sizes.row: menu row metrics: px-2 py-1.5, min-height 32, 14px type

notes: The popup family collapsed: SelectPopup/SelectItemList/SelectItemBuilder/SelectItemButton/SelectGroup/SelectLabel/EmptySelectItem/SelectPopupHandle are gone; rows are SelectItems and the popup body (search field, async rows, constraints) lives in primitives/select_popup.dart with the surface and search field injected so it stays layer-clean.
SelectExpandIcon collapsed into the default expandIcon icon; filled, the trigger constraints, alignment/widthConstraint and overlayConfiguration/adaptiveOverlay are gone.
The Material-only SelectItemButton mouse cursor override and the scroll chevron affordances are not ported.
Fixed: the old trigger resolved its disabled state from onChanged == null only, so enabled: true with no callback opened a dead popup; _enabled is now the single source of truth.
Fixed (B20/F1): menu_rows.RovingRow reserves its padding inside the 32px minimum and paints the hover/focus accent; SelectRow and the popup constraints rely on it.
The popup search field has no leading search icon (dropped with the two-file budget; not shadcn).

Multi selection is the sibling multi_select component (MultiSelect/MultiSelectItem/MultiSelectChip), built on Select's valueSelectionHandler/valueSelectionPredicate hooks and the menu component's MenuCheckboxItem; it lives in its own folder because the popup rows need menu/chip (layer 3) and the two-file select budget cannot hold the family.

canUnselect (click the selected item to clear), autoClose (default true) and themeable popup constraints (SelectTheme.constraints / popupConstraints) are restored; the default popup band is 192-320 wide and 240 high, always trigger-wide.
